objectives.where: Residential Area: hadiah mengalahkan Grandmaster Chadley di Fort Condor (posisi biasanya, barat markas Avalanche), plus 10.000 gil.

objectives.name: Game, Set, Master
objectives.where: Jadi grandmaster Fort Condor. Versi Hard (Condor Queen) via replay.

objectives.name: The Handoff
objectives.where: Ikuti Nayo dan lawan anak buah Don Corneo di Municipal Storage Area. Satu guide menyebut hadiah Chthonian Armlet di sini (belum pasti).

objectives.name: Kindred Cord
objectives.where: Municipal Storage Area: setelah dirampok anak buah Corneo, ujung jalur baru melewati gedung tempat ID dibuat; hancurkan dinding, chest ada di depannya.

objectives.name: Back to Base
objectives.where: Kembali ke markas Avalanche.

objectives.name: Change of Plans
objectives.where: Zhijie kabur dari penjaga; ikuti Nayo ke arah stasiun dan pilar.

objectives.name: After Him
objectives.where: Lewati Shipping Facility menuju pilar.

objectives.name: Indurate Staff
objectives.where: Shipping Facility Connecting Passage: lewat gerbang pagar terbuka dekat stasiun, chest ungu di area terbuka di jalur cerita (After Him).

objectives.name: Tracking Zhijie / Conveyor Belt Bedlam
objectives.where: Matikan conveyor dengan lempar shuriken ke saklar.

objectives.name: Gozu Drive
objectives.where: Bagian Double Back setelah adegan jatuh: drop otomatis dari Horned Cripshay pertama di area terbuka.

objectives.name: Fort Condor: Sweeper
objectives.where: Ward 3: setelah tiga Cripshay, turun tangga kanan; chest di pojok (antara tiang luncur pertama dan kedua).

objectives.name: Prayer
objectives.where: Ward 3: turun tangga ke area bawah conveyor, kalahkan dua Lesser Drake; materia di pojok belakang dekat tempat lempar senjata untuk menghentikan conveyor.

objectives.name: Steel Reaper
objectives.where: Ward 1: chest ungu di kiri dinding panjat kuning, di tepi scaffolding sebelum wall-run pertama (Double Back).

objectives.name: Double Back
objectives.where: Setelah jatuh, kembali naik lewat wall-run. Elite Horned Cripshay (lemah es) di area terbuka; Wrath Hound di tangga kanan.

objectives.name: Elemental
objectives.where: Ward 1: platform tengah, dicapai lewat saklar dan dinding panjat yang berputar (puzzle wall-run).

objectives.name: Fort Condor: Assassin Board III
objectives.where: Ward 2: setelah grup Toxirat, naik tangga kiri; chest/pod kuning terlihat jelas.

objectives.name: Main Pillar Maintenance
objectives.where: Masuk area perawatan pilar.

objectives.name: Magic Up
objectives.where: Perimeter Wall: di ujung barisan kontainer/conveyor yang berhenti, lompat ke kiri; materia di pojok sebelum wall-run.

objectives.name: Mezu Drive
objectives.where: Temporary Storage Area: drop otomatis dari Levrikon pertama (fight wajib), dekat Waste Disposal Plant.

objectives.name: Lightning
objectives.where: Central Maintenance Facility: ujung jalan setapak di ruang besar dalam gedung, dekat bangku dan vending machine, sebelum turun ke boss.

objectives.name: Save Zhijie
objectives.where: Ekor lemah petir, kepala aman diserang saat Pressured. Hancurkan Containment Drone.

objectives.name: Yuffie/Sonon Manuscripts Vol. I-X
objectives.where: Hanya Hard Mode (setelah tamat sekali): Vol. I-VII dari lawan Fort Condor versi Hard (Rank 5) di Sector 7 Slums, VIII dari Horned Cripshay, IX dari Levrikon, X dari Gigantipede.

objectives.name: Shinra Building or Bust
objectives.where: Dapat ID karyawan Shinra; chapter selesai.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: beresin Fort Condor, Chadley/Ramuh, Happy Turtle flyer & toko di slum. Setelah bicara dengan petugas kereta di stasiun, chapter selesai.

objectives.name: Takes Two IDs to Tango
objectives.where: Selesaikan Chapter 1 INTERmission (satu sumber mengaitkannya ke Chapter 2).

chapters.title: INTERmission 2: Covert Ops
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Chapter linear di bawah tanah Shinra HQ. Setelah The Invitation (gelombang musuh di Testing Ground B20) kamu nggak bisa balik ke lantai B14-B16, jadi Box Buster dan chest harus beres dulu.

objectives.name: Scarlet's Trap / A Way Out
objectives.where: Mulai di B16 Advanced Weaponry Inspection; Scarlet kirim Slug-Ray, Cutter, Monodrive, Shock-Ray.

objectives.name: Combat Simulator INTERmission (replay)
objectives.where: Pasca-tamat lewat Chapter Select: terminal Shinra Combat Simulator muncul di awal Chapter 2; berisi tantangan bintang 3, 4 dan 7 untuk Yuffie dan Sonon.

objectives.name: Gotterdammerung (Pride and Joy Mk 0.5)
objectives.where: Simulator di awal Chapter 2 (pasca-tamat): selesaikan tantangan bintang 3 dan 4 (Bahamut, Ifrit, Ramuh), lalu tantangan bintang 7 vs. Pride and Joy Mk 0.5. Hadiah 2 Gotterdammerung.

objectives.name: Gotterdammerung (Weiss)
objectives.where: Bukan di INTERmission: tantangan bintang 7 'Three-person Team vs. The Immaculate' di simulator Chadley game utama (Chapter 17) setelah INTERmission tamat. Hadiah 2 Gotterdammerung.

objectives.name: Find That Materia
objectives.where: Nyalakan lagi listrik di Compressor Facilities; tiga kontainer materia terbuka.

objectives.name: Ninja Cannonball
objectives.where: Compressor Facilities (B15): setelah listrik nyala lewat panel tengah, balik badan; materia di tabung tepat di seberang terminal.

objectives.name: Steadfast Block
objectives.where: Compressor Facilities (B15): di salah satu mesin samping, sisi kanan lift terkunci (jalan ke barat di walkway).

objectives.name: Skill Master
objectives.where: Compressor Facilities (B15): kapsul di sisi berlawanan dari Steadfast Block (ikuti walkway ke timur).

objectives.name: The Scent of Materia / Secret Vault
objectives.where: Jelajahi area perawatan; ada jalan ke Secret Vault.

objectives.name: Ribbon
objectives.where: Central Terminal Utility Access (B14): lompat ke pipa dekat konsol, ambil pipa kiri dan panjat dinding generator ke balkon ujung timur/tenggara; chest di sana.

objectives.name: Volant Armlet
objectives.where: Maintenance Facilities (B14): di ruang setelah pipa, naik tangga pendek lalu ambil jalan kecil ke kiri (cabang selatan); chest.

objectives.name: Djinn Staff
objectives.where: Maintenance Facilities (B14): setelah Armored Magitrooper pertama, lorong berikutnya lewat pintu kiri; chest ungu.

objectives.name: Shinra Box Buster
objectives.where: Training Room B14: setelah Power Grid level 2 nyala, pintu di belakang terbuka (Discovery Secret Vault); pakai Training Console.

objectives.name: ATB Assist
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, capai 5.000 poin.

objectives.name: ATB Boost
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, capai 10.000 poin.

objectives.name: ATB Stagger
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, capai 20.000 poin (membuka SOLDIER Training).

objectives.name: Box Buster: SOLDIER Training
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): terbuka setelah 20.000 poin di Basic Training; 10.000 poin Magnify, 30.000 Gil Up, 50.000 EXP Up.

objectives.name: Materia Maven
objectives.where: Dapat semua materia Box Buster (Basic + SOLDIER Training, difficulty apa pun).

objectives.name: The Hunt Continues
objectives.where: Terus ke arah kantor Scarlet.

objectives.name: Time
objectives.where: Central Terminal Utility Access: dari konsol cerita, panjat pipa kiri, panjat dinding, belok kiri lalu ayun lewat dua kait gantung ke platform; materia di lantai.

objectives.name: Healing Carcanet
objectives.where: Central Terminal Utility Access (B13): setelah menembak palang besi jadi jembatan, naik pipa ke kiri sebelum menyeberang girder kedua; chest kuning di platform ujung.

objectives.name: AP Up
objectives.where: Materia Research Facility (B13): setelah dua musuh Magitek lapis baja dan hologram Scarlet, periksa tabung tempat Yuffie terbanting sebelum keluar ruangan.

objectives.name: The Invitation
objectives.where: Turun ke B20 Testing Ground dan bertahan dari beberapa gelombang.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: ambil Ribbon, Volant Armlet, Djinn Staff, AP Up, Time, Healing Carcanet & beresin Box Buster. Setelah naik lift platform di awal The Invitation, B14, B13 & Secret Vault tertutup.

objectives.name: Iron Maiden
objectives.where: Testing Ground - 4th Station (B20, The Invitation): curi dari M.O.T.H. Unit (peluang kecil). Lebih mudah: beli di vending machine.

objectives.name: A Fateful Confrontation
objectives.where: Jaga jarak saat dia pakai claymore; ganti strategi saat senjata berubah.

objectives.name: Firebird Armlet
objectives.where: Heavy Weapons Platform Testing: hadiah otomatis setelah mengalahkan Scarlet dan Crimson Mare (A Fateful Confrontation).

objectives.name: A New Threat / Escape
objectives.where: Lawan prajurit Deepground dan Projector, lalu kabur lewat Combat Simulator prototipe (4 gelombang).

objectives.name: Dread / The Journey Continues
objectives.where: Boss terakhir, 4 fase. Isi bar di bangku sebelum masuk.

objectives.name: Yuffie/Sonon Manuscripts Vol. XI-XIV
objectives.where: Hanya Hard Mode: XI dari Deathwheel, XII dari Scarlet & Crimson Mare, XIII dari Projector, XIV dari Nero the Sable.

objectives.name: Out of Darkness's Clutches
objectives.where: Selesaikan Chapter 2 INTERmission. Trofi Hard kedua chapter: The Road to Revenge.
